messages.subject: Re: Date time plot problem
parts:
Again, it's really hard to diagnose your problem without a
reproducible example. The most likely problem is simply that your
dates aren't in the correct format, but there's no way to tell with
just a textual description of the data frame. Have a look at the
output of str(df_ElTab) - I suspect it will give you some insight into
the problem.

Regards,

Hadley

Try formatting the dates and times before passing them to ggplot2.

df <- read.table(textConnection("

190 Morbla El Taburete 03/30/07 04:59:00
191 Morbla El Taburete 03/30/07 05:17:00
192 Ptequa El Taburete 03/30/07 05:47:00
193 Morbla El Taburete 03/30/07 06:13:00
194 Morbla El Taburete 03/30/07 06:20:00
195 Ptequa El Taburete 03/30/07 06:30:00
196 Ptequa El Taburete 03/30/07 06:38:00
197 Ptequa El Taburete 03/30/07 06:46:00
198 Ptequa El Taburete 03/30/07 06:47:00
199 Ptequa El Taburete 03/30/07 06:48:00

")
)
closeAllConnections()

library(chron)

names(df) <- c("id", "species", "V3", "V4", "date", "time")
df$times <- times(df$time,out.form = "h:m")
df$dates <- dates(as.character(df$date), format="m/d/y")

qplot(data=df, date, time, colour = species)
